capex: By our estimates, a disproportionate share of this expansion was captured by us, doubling retails year -on-year and delivering a market share of almost 60% in retail terms.

risks: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

about: Bajaj Auto, the flagship company of Bajaj Group, is a two-wheeler and three-wheeler manufacturing company that exports to 79 countries across several countries in Latin America, Southeast Asia, and many more. Its headquarter is in Pune, India. The company has acquired 76% of the KTM Brand which manufactures sports and super sports two-wheelers, which was 14% in 2007 when the company first acquired KTM.
